sources.name: lyonscolorado.com
sources.notes: Retired 20 October 2026: lyonscolorado.com is an alias of the Town of Lyons' CivicPlus site (townoflyons-com, confirmed), not a chamber; its calendar RSS is the same feed. Its robots.txt also timed out twice in three minutes on 20 October.

sources.name: townoflyons.com
sources.notes: Feed found by autodiscovery on 4 October 2026 and read successfully once. CivicPlus calendar RSS with structured event dates, times and location; lists the next few weeks (13 items on 4 October).

sources.name: bouldercounty.gov
sources.notes: Feed found by autodiscovery on 4 October 2026 and read successfully once. County-wide feed (The Events Calendar; 30 upcoming items on 4 October); only items whose location names Lyons are taken.

sources.name: lyons.librarycalendar.com
sources.lastNote: robots.txt asks automated clients not to fetch it
sources.notes: Its iCal feed (feedUrl) is offered to readers to subscribe to in a calendar app. The site's robots.txt disallows every path for agents it does not name, so the event pages are not read; the feed is, under robots: subscribe, by the nightly re-check only, once a night, to confirm listings already on the guide (decided 17 October 2026 under the owner's delegation; the permission request of docs/SOURCE-PERMISSION-EMAILS.md stands as a courtesy). Type stays manual: ingest does not read it until the library answers. Found 4 October 2026; about 120 events, UTC times.
